region: Gale / Mount Sharp boxwork bolgesi (Curiosity sol ~4459-4983)
crs_note: origin_xy_m = izgaranin sol ust kosesi (piksel kenari), kaynak DTM projeksiyonunda. px = [sutun, satir]; sutun = (x - origin_x) / res_m, satir = (origin_y - y) / res_m; hucre indeksi = floor. MMGIS waypoint easting/northing ayni projeksiyonda. Frontend piksel uzayinda (Leaflet CRS.Simple).

source.dem: USGS MSL Gale Merged DEM 1m v3 (2x2 blok ortalamasi)
source.ortho: USGS MSL Gale Merged Orthophoto 25cm v3

layers.entropy: layers/entropy.npy  float32, 0-1 (model belirsizliği, 1 = hiç emin değil)
layers.elevation_norm: layers/elevation_norm.npy  float32, 0-1 (min-max; gercek deger = v*(max-min)+min, bkz. normalization)
layers.slope_norm: layers/slope_norm.npy  float32, 0-1 (min-max; gercek deger = v*(max-min)+min, bkz. normalization)
